item.title: Treasury Unveils Autumn Fiscal Framework Ahead of Parliamentary Debate
item.dc:creator: Eleanor Vance
item.description: The Chancellor announced new capital investment guidelines today in Westminster, outlining multi-year infrastructure allocations for regional transit. Ministers pledged that public borrowing targets would remain within statutory ceilings.

item.title: Met Office Issues Amber Weather Alert Across Scottish Highlands
item.dc:creator: Alistair Campbell
item.description: Severe gales and persistent rainfall are forecast to disrupt travel networks across northern Scotland through Thursday evening. Transport authorities advised motorists to avoid unnecessary journeys on exposed mountain passes.
